## Requirements (from spec)
1. ADR-071 coupling decision — one `pathways` connector vs three. DECISION: ONE `pathways`
   connector w/ 3 per-pathway extractors (shared parser layers + shared epistemic guard).
2. Parser layers (LD-F17, ADR-033-deferred) in parsing/ + unit tests; `sig-parsing classify`
   recognises new document genres.
3. Pathway connectors emit P17 claims (vendor/product, procurement, policy, deployment ONLY
   when evidence says so) w/ procured≠deployed rule; registry rows + packets per new source.
4. tests/connectors/test_pathway_coverage.py: every P17 pathway ≥1 connector claim; rendered
   into docs/build/STAGE5_CONNECTORS.md.
5. Run: fixture replay; live refuses exit 3 for unflipped.
6. ADR-071, RISK-P21-16, RISK-P21-17, traceability, COVERAGE_MATRIX P17 ids → MET,
   RISK-P17-03 → retired by P21.9 suffix.

## Epistemic rule (§46 RISK-P21-16)
procured NEVER implies deployed. deployment claim requires deployment-genre document.
Genres: procurement_record, policy_document, deployment_report, vendor_disclosure, agenda_minutes.
